svg.title: HE-01.6 animated: plant run F-03
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping animation of plant run F-03 for HE-01.6: the Corolla's lateral offset on a straightened road from 1 s before the fault to 4.5 s after it, the offset plot with a moving cursor and the 0.5 s FTTI band, and the events: fault: command frozen mid lane change: the last frame repeats at 0.00 s; body on the 3.7 m lane line at 0.62 s; driver cue: 0.2 m drift at 0.98 s; driver starts to correct at 2.48 s.
svg.text: The car does not stop in the target lane and runs on into the lane beyond
Plant run F-03: 80 km/h, command frozen 27 % into a lane change to the left (EC-11)
road straightened; the car keeps its place, the road moves
body on the 3.7 m lane line (0.96 m)
